briefings.title: 🇺🇸 Operation Epic Fury Update by WAR Sec. Pete Hegseth & Gen. Raizin Caine at The Pentagon [LIVE]
briefings.tldr: One month into Operation Epic Fury, U.S. leadership reports the successful degradation of Iranian military morale and infrastructure through 11,000+ strikes, while maintaining "very real" negotiations backed by a "win-first" military posture.
